scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "cyan,magenta" "yarn workspace server dev" "yarn workspace client dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @app/shared build && yarn workspace server build && yarn workspace client build
scripts.check: yarn workspace client run check && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace client run check && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit
